name: Anatoliy Gennady Romanov
original_name: 阿纳托利·根纳季·罗曼诺夫
source: Anatoliy is always seen with Coay. He is good at bluffing and it really works. It is said that he is a member of the Russian royal family but no one knows for sure. He is courteous and eloquent, but in a frivolous fashion. All things aside, he is very popular in school. It is said he once received almost a hundred boxes of chocolate on Valentine's day. He treasures Coay and she adores him.
